activationRules: Only verified identity rows may be considered. Static entries are never live readiness evidence.
Current readable spec, exact actual learned non-passive activation ID, resolved override and ALL additional requiredTalentSpellIDs are mandatory.
If a consumer cannot implement a row gate, exclude that row from confirmed availability and retain coverage Unknown. Do not silently ignore prerequisites.
Only activation must be non-passive; required passive talent modifiers must still be positively selected/known.
Cooldown/held/charges/usability/resources/form/target/inventory/use/aura observations remain independent. A known button does not imply ready or suitable for a specific hit.
Do not use static duration/resource/charge fields as live state. Invalidate cached observations on spec/talent/override identity change.
